title: Reset the repository state
description: Reset HEAD to a given state.

examples.description: Reset completely to the state of origin/main
Example using the 'mode' parameter: reset mode (--soft, --mixed, --hard). Replace Full with the value that fits your environment.

notes: WARNING: --hard discards the changes. --soft keeps everything staged, --mixed unstages.

windowsExamples.description: Windows example using git. Replace the parameters between <> with your values.

linuxExamples.description: Undo the last commit and keep the changes
Example using the 'target' parameter: target commit. Replace srv-web-01.contoso.com with the value that fits your environment.
